Council approves new budget

The city council voted on Tuesday to approve the new budget, which allocates funds for road repairs, public transport improvements, new libraries and a renovated swimming pool. Councillors debated for six hours before the final vote, which passed by nine votes to four.

The mayor said the plan would be funded without raising local taxes, relying instead on savings from merged departments and a new parking scheme. Opposition members argued the savings were optimistic and asked for a review in six months, which the council agreed to schedule.
